validationNotes: All non-browser reef QA modules passed, including geometry, materials, fin normals, navigation, chemistry and anemone behavior. Caustics/browser checks reviewed through Codex UI; no new frame-rate or screenshot-baseline measurements claimed.
Three two-minute full communities and three five-minute day/night communities retain 21 fish, individual motion, upright turns, fish/obstacle clearance and paused state.
Eighteen isolated feeding cases across six swimming species require actual mouth contact; separate mandarin terrain/feeding checks pass.
School alignment is checked against an unrelated-fish counterfactual, not against profile constants.
Speeds and rhythms are authored animation estimates, not measured adult physiological performance. Research sources are in SWIMMING-RESEARCH.md and the reef guide.
Freshwater source and bundles remain unchanged; existing 83-asset sync and release guards pass.
